extra.description: Single-cell transcriptomics enables profiling of cellular states at unprecedented resolution, but its high dimensionality, sparsity, and technical batch effects pose significant challenges for representation learning. Existing single-cell foundation models typically encode each cell independently or only model cells from the same batch for denoising, thereby underutilizing the rich relational information across batches and cell types to model gene expression patterns. We argue that single-cell models can benefit from more informative cell-context modeling. By comparing consistency and variation across cells, models can capture fine-grained gene-gene dependencies associated with cell states, which are essential for learning high-quality representations. Inspired by the use of multiple sequence alignment (MSA) context in protein modeling, we propose CellMSA, a single-cell representation learning framework that introduces an MSA-inspired inductive bias into transcriptomic modeling. For each target cell, CellMSA retrieves relevant cells from different batches and biologically related cell types as context, and summarizes cross-cell patterns into a context-dependent gene-pair representation. This representation is then injected into a pair-aware target-cell encoder for fine-grained representation learning. We pretrain CellMSA on a large-scale human single-cell corpus of approximately 109 million cell observations, including 65.6 million primary observations. Experiments show that our framework consistently outperforms existing methods across multiple benchmarks. Code is available at the following repository: https://github.com/PharMolix/CellMSA.

items.title: Efficient and Generalizable Archetypal Analysis for Discrete Data
items.title_zh: 离散数据的高效且可泛化的原型分析
items.summary_zh: 原型分析（AA）将观测表示为极端数据驱动轮廓的凸组合，产生复杂数据集的可解释低维描述。经典 AA 依赖最小二乘目标，不适合离散观测如二元、计数和分类数据。我们引入一个高效的基于似然的 AA 框架，支持 Bernoulli、Poisson 和多项观测模型。我们的优化方案采用负对数似然的局部二次近似，通过顺序最小优化（SMO）和活动集方法实现约束更新。通过限制活动集同时保持单纯形可行性来提高可扩展性。我们进一步引入交叉验证预测似然准则来选择原型数量，提供了一种替代重建误差启发式和基于稳定性诊断的有原则方法。合成实验展示了计算效率和模型复杂度的准确恢复。应用于单细胞 RNA 测序、微生物组组成和体细胞突变数据表明，学习的原型捕获可解释的领域特定结构，同时实现有竞争力的似然拟合和稳定解。总体而言，所提出的框架实现了离散数据的高效基于似然的原型分析，并辅以基于预测似然的模型选择。

extra.description: Archetypal Analysis (AA) represents observations as convex combinations of extremal data-driven profiles, yielding interpretable low-dimensional descriptions of complex datasets. Classical AA relies on a least-squares objective, which is poorly suited to discrete observations such as binary, count, and categorical data. We introduce an efficient likelihood-based framework for AA supporting Bernoulli, Poisson, and multinomial observation models. Our optimization scheme employs local quadratic approximations of the negative log-likelihood, enabling constrained updates through sequential minimal optimization (SMO) and an active-set method. Scalability is improved by bounding the active set while preserving simplex feasibility. We further introduce a cross-validated predictive likelihood criterion for selecting the number of archetypes, providing a principled alternative to reconstruction-error heuristics and stability-based diagnostics. Synthetic experiments demonstrate computational efficiency and accurate recovery of model complexity. Applications to single-cell RNA sequencing, microbiome composition, and somatic mutation data show that the learned archetypes capture interpretable domain-specific structures while achieving competitive likelihood fits and stable solutions. Overall, the proposed framework enables efficient likelihood-based archetypal analysis of discrete data, complemented by predictive likelihood-based model selection.

items.title: Predictive Multiplicity in Cell-Fate Assignment: Label-Free Rashomon Sets and the Limits of Per-Cell Certification
items.title_zh: 细胞命运分配中的预测多重性：无标签 Rashomon 集和逐细胞认证的局限
items.summary_zh: 单细胞轨迹推断将转录组测量映射到发育连续体上，但同样拟合数据的配置可能分配冲突的细胞命运。FateMultiplicity 是一个无标签框架，通过评估交叉拟合留出基因上的模型差异，在非劣效性测试下针对随机种子变异进行校准，构建统计可接受的模型集或 Rashomon 集，无需谱系标签。多重性很大，更多取决于模型空间的多样性而非其大小：第二个算法的十二种配置暴露 20.0% 的细胞，而第一个算法的二十四种配置暴露 3.8%。然后测试逐细胞认证命运边际 FM 是否比拟合模型已提供的产生更可靠的分配，结果并非如此。在模拟真实值上，在相同细胞上，FM 以 AUC 0.682 区分错误分配，而基线配置自身的决策边际为 0.965（p = 0.003），种子离散基线为 0.854。信息量由所接纳集的广度而非其基数决定：在基数四时，种子重拟合给出 0.933，超参数扰动集给出 0.701。将下确界放宽到

extra.description: Single-cell trajectory inference maps transcriptomic measurements onto developmental continua, yet configurations that fit the data equally well can assign conflicting cell fates. FateMultiplicity is a label-free framework that constructs a statistically admissible model set, or Rashomon set, without lineage labels, by evaluating model discrepancy on cross-fitted held-out genes under non-inferiority testing calibrated against random-seed variation. Multiplicity is large and depends more on the diversity of the model space than its size: twelve configurations of a second algorithm expose 20.0% of cells where twenty-four of the first expose 3.8%. Whether the per-cell certified fate margin FM yields more reliable assignments than the fitted model already provides is then tested, and it does not. On simulation ground truth, on the same cells, FM discriminates misassignment at AUC 0.682, against 0.965 for the baseline configuration's own decision margin (p = 0.003) and 0.854 for a seed-dispersion baseline. Informativeness is governed by the breadth of the admitted set, not its cardinality: at cardinality four, seed refits give 0.933 and hyperparameter-perturbed sets 0.701. Relaxing the infimum to a q-quantile recovers discrimination but converges toward the single model's own confidence; the supremum reaches 0.973 because theta*'s membership bounds it from below, while the infimum is unanchored. Multiplicity in trajectory inference is worth measuring and reporting, but per-cell certification over a label-free Rashomon set is not a route to more reliable fate calls. Two constructions survive: a margin-erosion ratio separates real from spurious branch points in simulation (AUC 0.890, untested on real data), and against clonally observed fate, uncertified cells disagree with their clone's outcome 16.4 percentage points more often than certified cells (p < 0.001).

items.title: CircuitATLAS: Agentic reasoning over a systems neuroscience knowledge graph for target discovery in circuitopathies
items.title_zh: CircuitATLAS：在系统神经科学知识图谱上进行代理推理以发现 circuitopathies 中的靶点
items.summary_zh: 神经疾病药物发现传统上聚焦于疾病改变的分子。但导致病理的分子未必是逆转病理的最佳切入点。在此，我们追问哪些原本未被改变的分子控制点可以被用来将病理神经环路恢复至功能状态。我们提出CircuitATLAS，一个基于溯源的系统神经科学知识图谱和智能体框架，用于环路病中的靶点发现。它结构化地整合了来自文献的跨疾病、表型、电生理、环路、脑区、细胞类型和分子效应器的关系，同时刻意排除直接的疾病-基因和疾病-蛋白边以减少捷径推理。该图谱包含383万个节点和766万条边，其中包括531万条LLM提取的关系，并整合了人类细胞图谱等结构化数据集和新的多模态在体测量。随后我们引入一个智能体工作流，从可测量的疾病表型出发，经由其环路和细胞基质，推理至分子干预、治疗可行性和临床约束。最后，我们引入一个人工治理的在体实验室在环，将假设生成与实验迭代连接起来。在该框架内，一个智能体提名ATP1A3——神经元alpha

extra.description: Drug discovery for neurological disease has traditionally centered on the molecules altered by disease. But the molecules that cause pathology are not necessarily the best points from which to reverse it. Here, we ask which otherwise unaltered molecular control points can be engaged to restore pathological neural circuits toward functional states. We present CircuitATLAS, a provenance-grounded systems-neuroscience knowledge graph and agentic framework for target discovery in circuitopathies. It structures literature-derived relationships across diseases, phenotypes, electrophysiology, circuits, brain regions, cell types and molecular effectors, while deliberately excluding direct disease-gene and disease-protein edges to reduce shortcut reasoning. The graph contains 3.83 million nodes and 7.66 million edges, including 5.31 million LLM-extracted relations, and incorporates structured datasets such as the Human Cell Atlas and new multimodal in vivo measurements. We then introduce an agentic workflow that reasons from measurable disease phenotypes through their circuit and cellular substrates to molecular interventions, therapeutic feasibility and clinical constraints. Finally, we introduce a human-governed in vivo lab-in-the-loop linking hypothesis generation to experimental iteration. Within this framework an agent nominated ATP1A3, the neuronal alpha3 Na+/K+-ATPase, as a control point on cortical excitability; interneuron-restricted expression of ATP1A3 abolished the beta- and gamma-band response to a focal 4-aminopyridine challenge in vivo, and the validated target was then carried into a structure-guided small-molecule campaign terminating in a defined assay to resolve the direction of modulation. CircuitATLAS thus provides a framework for discovering therapeutics based not only on what is molecularly disrupted in disease, but on what can be controlled to restore circuit function.

items.title: Circular Data Analysis for Spatial Omics
items.title_zh: 空间组学的环形数据分析
items.summary_zh: 组学中许多生物量本质上是周期性的或方向性的，包括昼夜节律相位、细胞周期位置和细胞方向。将此类量当作普通线性变量处理会引入人为不连续并模糊生物学解释。环形方法在方向统计、生物信息学和空间统计中已发展成熟，但组学应用的实践指南仍然有限。我们提出单细胞和空间组学中环形数据分析的关键考量，包括环形量的来源和观测单位、推断或预测目标、组织组成与残余空间依赖的区分，以及适当模型的选择。我们描述了环形表示、推断、聚类、回归、机器学习和空间分析的相关方法，以及代表性的R软件。通过阿尔茨海默病小鼠模型中推导的昼夜节律峰值相位和人类卵巢癌中潜在细胞周期位置的空间转录组案例研究，展示了它们的实际应用。这些例子说明了角度的定义、其观测单位和组织异质性如何塑造适当的分析和解释，包括何时空间建模是不必要的。我们最后提出实践建议和未来方法学发展方向。

extra.description: Many biological quantities in omics are inherently periodic or directional, including circadian phase, cell-cycle position, and cellular orientation. Treating such quantities as ordinary linear variables can introduce artificial discontinuities and obscure biological interpretation. Circular methods are well developed across directional statistics, bioinformatics, and spatial statistics, but practical guidance for omics applications remains limited. We present key considerations for circular data analysis in single-cell and spatial omics, including the provenance and observational unit of the circular quantity, the inferential or predictive objective, the distinction between tissue composition and residual spatial dependence, and the choice of appropriate models. We describe relevant approaches for circular representation, inference, clustering, regression, machine learning, and spatial analysis, together with representative R software. Their practical use is illustrated through spatial transcriptomic case studies of derived circadian peak phase in a mouse model of Alzheimer's disease and latent cell-cycle position in human ovarian cancer. These examples demonstrate how the definition of the angle, its observational unit, and tissue heterogeneity shape appropriate analysis and interpretation, including when spatial modeling is not warranted. We conclude with practical recommendations and directions for future methodological development.

items.title: Protocol for Discovering Convergent Molecular Networks across Multi-Omics Datasets Using Network Propagation
items.title_zh: 使用网络传播跨多组学数据集发现趋同分子网络的方案
items.summary_zh: 表型结果源于分子层之间的协调变化。尽管多组学数据捕捉互补的分子信号，但由于基因水平重叠有限，将其整合为连贯的生物机制仍然具有挑战性。网络传播将每个数据集中的重要基因命中映射到先验知识分子相互作用网络上，并将其信号扩散到邻近基因。对传播网络进行数学整合，随后进行聚类和通路富集，可揭示共享分子网络，从而指出跨正交分子层捕捉到的核心生物学。

extra.description: Phenotypic outcomes arise from coordinated changes across molecular layers. Although multi-omics data capture complementary molecular signals, integrating them into coherent biological mechanisms remains challenging due to limited overlap at the gene level. Network propagation maps significant gene hits from each dataset onto a prior knowledge molecular interaction network and diffuses their signals to neighboring genes. Mathematical integration of propagated networks, followed by clustering and pathway enrichment, reveals shared molecular networks, pinpointing the core biology captured across orthogonal molecular layers.

items.title: BaseCamp --- An Agentic AI Framework for Automating DNA Sequencing Data Pipelines
items.title_zh: BaseCamp --- 一种用于自动化 DNA 测序数据流程的智能体 AI 框架
items.summary_zh: DNA 测序流程，涵盖质量控制、比对、变异检测和注释，如今已由工作流管理系统可靠执行，这些系统大规模编排成熟的生物信息学工具。仍然依赖人工的是围绕该执行的决策层：选择适合样本和平台的质量阈值、裁定边界变异检测、诊断异常，以及确定哪些发现值得专家审查。这些决策重复、判断密集、在不同操作者之间不一致，且常常未被记录。本文介绍 BaseCamp，一种用于自动化 DNA 测序流程决策层的新型智能体 AI 框架。该框架将流程分解为六个专门 AI 智能体，涵盖样本接收和质量控制、比对、变异检测、注释、跨阶段监测和报告。关键的是，BaseCamp 智能体不执行序列分析：成熟工具执行比对、检测和注释，而智能体在其中选择、配置、解释其输出并决定后续步骤。这将语言模型推理限制在其可靠的判断层，并保留现有工具保证的可重复性。智能体推理由一个经过微调、领域专门化的大型语言模型联盟驱动，由中央推理 LLM 协调，在

extra.description: DNA sequencing pipelines, spanning quality control, alignment, variant calling, and annotation, are now reliably executed by workflow management systems that orchestrate established bioinformatics tools at scale. What remains manual is the decision layer surrounding that execution: selecting quality thresholds appropriate to a sample and platform, adjudicating borderline variant calls, diagnosing anomalies, and determining which findings warrant expert review. These decisions are repetitive, judgment-intensive, inconsistent across operators, and frequently undocumented. This paper introduces BaseCamp, a novel agentic AI framework for automating the decision layer of DNA sequencing pipelines. The framework decomposes the pipeline into six specialized AI agents, covering sample intake and quality control, alignment, variant calling, annotation, cross-stage monitoring, and reporting. Critically, BaseCamp agents do not perform sequence analysis: established tools execute alignment, calling, and annotation, while the agents select among them, configure them, interpret their output, and decide what follows. This confines language model reasoning to the judgment layer where it is reliable and preserves the reproducibility existing tooling guarantees. Agent reasoning is powered by a consortium of fine-tuned, domain-specialized large language models coordinated by a central reasoning LLM, executing locally so no sequencing data leaves the operating environment, under human-in-the-loop orchestration. Evaluation shows agent-generated configurations are concordant with expert practice, that an explicit filtering ledger renders inspectable what filtering otherwise removes without trace, and that cross-stage anomaly detection surfaces conditions execution monitoring misses. BaseCamp offers a generalizable blueprint for agentic automation of scientific data pipelines.

items.title: Orchestra: Corroboration-Based Regulatory Candidate Discovery via Composed Bioinformatics MCP Agents
items.title_zh: Orchestra：通过组合生物信息学MCP智能体进行基于佐证的调控候选发现
items.summary_zh: Orchestra将两个独立构建的生物信息学MCP服务器——RegNetAgents（从ARACNe网络推断基因调控网络拓扑）和CASCADE（提供四个独立证据源：LINCS敲低、DepMap必需性、超级增强子状态、DoRothEA转录因子置信度）——组合成一个通过模型上下文协议暴露的多智能体工作流。其核心架构主张是，要求RegNetAgents的拓扑证据和CASCADE的实验证据在候选调控因子上达成一致，比任一单独来源产生更可信的候选——此前未直接测试，因为RegNetAgents自身的验证仅询问其候选列表是否优于随机。我们在TCGA肿瘤获得性调控因子层级（基因肿瘤ARACNe网络中但不在GREmLN群体平均基线中的调控因子）上测试，通过ARACNe互信息（MI）边权重选择候选。在RegNetAgents已发表的BRCA/COAD焦点基因面板及匹配阴性对照上，CASCADE 4个来源中至

extra.description: Orchestra composes two independently built bioinformatics MCP servers -- RegNetAgents, which infers gene regulatory network topology from ARACNe networks, and CASCADE, which supplies four independent evidence sources (LINCS knockdown, DepMap essentiality, super-enhancer status, DoRothEA transcription-factor confidence) -- into one multi-agent workflow exposed via the Model Context Protocol. Its central architectural claim is that requiring RegNetAgents' topology evidence and CASCADE's experimental evidence to agree on a candidate regulator yields a more trustworthy candidate than either alone -- not previously tested directly, since RegNetAgents' own validation asked only whether its candidate lists beat chance. We test this on the TCGA tumor-acquired regulator tier (regulators in a gene's tumor ARACNe network but absent from the GREmLN population-averaged baseline), selecting candidates by ARACNe mutual-information (MI) edge weight. On RegNetAgents' published BRCA/COAD focal-gene panel plus matched negative controls, agreement among at least 2 of the 4 CASCADE sources predicts OncoKB cancer-gene status among focal genes (odds ratio 2.89, Benjamini-Hochberg-adjusted p=0.0166) but not among negative controls (p=0.0721); a single source is not diagnostic for either group. The pattern replicates and strengthens in a third cancer type, STAD, on a separately constructed panel (odds ratio 5.82), and against an independently curated ground truth (the Sanger COSMIC Cancer Gene Census). MI edge weight is the strongest single predictor overall (p=0.0003); a logistic-regression likelihood-ratio test confirms corroboration adds value beyond it in both panels (p=0.0234; p=0.0001). Every experiment invokes Orchestra's real agentic entry point.

items.title: On the estimation and validity of AI time horizons---a statistical look at the METR plot
items.title_zh: 论AI时间视界的估计与效度——对METR图的统计学审视
items.summary_zh: METR的50%时间视界衡量的是AI以50%概率解决的软件任务的人类完成时间，使AI能力可以用可解释的单位表达。在228个任务和26个AI上，我们使用样条和项目反应理论重新计算时间视界，以放松任务AI难度线性依赖于人类时间对数的假设。我们拟合的样条可以解释为一个将人类时间转换为AI难度的函数；它在2-30分钟区域近乎平坦，但在其他区域接近线性。因此，时间视界从3分钟跳到30分钟比从30分钟跳到5小时容易得多，尽管乘数同为10倍。总体而言，我们贡献了在交叉验证的适当评分规则套件下表现更好的时间视界点估计，以及用于评估时间视界构念效度的诊断图。我们建议将时间视界与诊断图一起解释，尤其是在新的基于时间视界的基准被提出或现有基准扩展到包含更长任务时。

extra.description: METR's 50\% time horizon measures the human completion time of software tasks that an AI solves with 50\% probability, allowing AI capabilities to be expressed in interpretable units. On 228 tasks and 26 AIs, we recompute the time horizons using splines and item-response theory to relax the assumption that the AI difficulty of a task depends linearly on the log of human time. Our fitted spline can be interpreted as a function that \emph{converts} human time to AI difficulty; it is nearly flat in a region from 2--30 min but close to linear elsewhere. Hence, a time-horizon jump from 3 min to 30 min is much easier than one from 30 min to 5 hours despite the same multiplier of $10 \times$. Overall, we contribute time-horizon point estimates that perform better under a cross-validated suite of proper scoring rules, as well as diagnostic plots for assessing time horizons' construct validity. We suggest that time horizons be interpreted together with the diagnostic plots, especially as new time-horizon-based benchmarks are proposed or existing ones grow to include longer tasks.

items.title: BrickBench: Evaluating Agentic Brick Design
items.title_zh: BrickBench：评估智能体积木设计
items.summary_zh: 我们提出BrickBench，一个用于智能体文本条件乐高套装设计的基准。给定一个提示，智能体被要求生成一个不仅满足语义和设计标准，而且可以物理搭建的组装体。为此，它必须从离散零件库中选择零件，并联合推理局部和全局约束。我们在三种规模和零件可用性不同的设置中评估有效性、对齐度和设计。我们提供BrickAgent，一个供编码智能体构建、检查和验证其设计的环境。我们发现领先的智能体在很大程度上满足可验证的物理和语义要求，但不及人类设计。我们在http://www.brickben.ch发布我们的基准和环境。

extra.description: We propose BrickBench, a benchmark for agentic text-conditioned LEGO-set design. Given a prompt, an agent is tasked with producing an assembly that not only satisfies semantic and design criteria, but that can also be physically built. To do so, it must select parts from a discrete library and reason jointly about local and global constraints. We score validity, alignment, and design across three settings that vary in scale and part availability. We provide BrickAgent, an environment for coding agents to construct, inspect, and validate their designs. We find that leading agents largely satisfy verifiable physical and semantic requirements, but fall short of human designs. We release our benchmark and environment at http://www.brickben.ch

items.title: Bi-FORK: Generative Modeling of High-Dimensional Bifurcating Systems
items.title_zh: Bi-FORK：高维分岔系统的生成建模
items.summary_zh: 分岔在物理系统中无处不在，从结构屈曲到流体和气候动力学，但在深度学习中仍 largely 未被探索。在对称破缺分岔处，单个输入允许多个同等有效的解，违反了大多数学习物理代理模型所基于的一对一假设。我们引入Bi-FORK，一个用于学习高维系统中这些一对多解映射的生成框架。Bi-FORK通过潜在流匹配生成完整轨迹，保持空间和时间连贯性，并使用排斥引导采样在单次摊销传递中恢复不同的解分支。我们在屈曲梁、机械超材料和Allen-Cahn相分离上评估Bi-FORK，涵盖连续、离散和场值分岔，离散化高达260,000个点。Bi-FORK恢复了多模态解结构，同时比先前方法扩展了几个数量级，为高维分岔物理系统打开了生成建模的大门。

extra.description: Bifurcations are ubiquitous in physical systems, from structural buckling to fluid and climate dynamics, yet they remain largely unexplored in deep learning. At a symmetry-breaking bifurcation, a single input admits multiple equally valid solutions, violating the one-to-one assumption underlying most learned physical surrogates. We introduce Bi-FORK, a generative framework for learning these one-to-many solution maps in high-dimensional systems. Bi-FORK generates complete trajectories through latent flow matching, preserving space and time coherence, and uses repulsion-guided sampling to recover distinct solution branches in a single amortized pass. We evaluate Bi-FORK on buckling beams, mechanical metamaterials, and Allen-Cahn phase separation, spanning continuous, discrete, and field-valued bifurcations with discretizations up to 260,000 points. Bi-FORK recovers the multimodal solution structure while scaling several orders of magnitude beyond prior approaches, opening generative modeling to high-dimensional bifurcating physical systems.

items.title: Beyond Spatio-Temporal Priors: A Generalizable Approach for Dense Correspondence Matching
items.title_zh: 超越时空先验：一种可泛化的稠密对应匹配方法
items.summary_zh: 稠密对应匹配历来受限于简化的时空先验，如平滑运动和刚性几何。虽然对经典任务有效，但这些假设在图像编辑和参考引导生成（IEG）中失效，因为变换可以保持视觉身份同时打破物理连续性。为了在此类变换中建立保持身份的对应关系，我们引入FreeMatching，一个可泛化框架，结合生成和语义基础表示，以及来自经典数据集、跟踪视频和合成场景的异构监督。教师引导的迭代精炼进一步改善了IEG中的对应关系，无需稠密对应标注。实验上，单个FreeMatching模型在具有挑战性的IEG图像对上大幅提升了对应质量，同时在经典基准上保持有竞争力的性能。此外，我们展示了其作为评估身份保持的定量指标的效用，其分数与人类判断相关。代码见https://github.com/luping-liu/FreeMatching。

extra.description: Dense correspondence matching has historically been bounded by simplifying spatio-temporal priors, such as smooth motion and rigid geometry. While effective for classical tasks, these assumptions break down in image editing and reference-guided generation (IEG), where transformations can preserve visual identity while breaking physical continuity. To establish identity-preserving correspondence across such transformations, we introduce FreeMatching, a generalizable framework combining generative and semantic foundation representations with heterogeneous supervision from classical datasets, tracked videos, and synthetic scenes. Teacher-guided iterative refinement further improves correspondence in IEG without dense correspondence annotations. Experimentally, a single FreeMatching model substantially improves correspondence quality on challenging IEG image pairs while retaining competitive performance on classical benchmarks. Furthermore, we demonstrate its utility as a quantitative metric for evaluating identity preservation, with scores that correlate with human judgment. The code is available at https://github.com/luping-liu/FreeMatching.

items.title: WOVEN: Weaving Visual World Modeling into Multimodal LLMs
items.title_zh: WOVEN：将视觉世界建模编织进多模态LLM
items.summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在空间、具身、物理和时间推理方面存在困难。我们假设这些失败反映了视觉转换推理中的共同缺陷，并测试这种能力是否可以作为共享训练原语，不同模型可以从不同监督来源学习并在不同任务中重用，并配有系统性训练配方。现有基准分别记录了这些缺陷，但不支持跨场景、动作和推理操作的受控比较。因此我们引入WOVEN，一个用于视觉转换推理的训练来源和基准，按场景、动作和推理类型组织转换监督，使用来自视频预训练生成模型的多样、真实rollout：36,076个示例，涵盖20种场景类型、5种动作类型和8种推理类型。我们首先评估38个前沿MLLM（如GPT-5.4和Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B），发现一个显著且系统性的缺陷：即使最强的模型也远低于人类，且失败在不同模型家族中反复出现并随规模持续。然后我们在WOVEN上训练多个规模的MLLM，发现它们学习到一个可广泛迁移的共享能力：仅约

extra.description: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) struggle with spatial, embodied, physical, and temporal reasoning. We hypothesize that these failures reflect a shared deficit in visual transition reasoning, and test whether this capability can serve as a shared training primitive, one that different models can learn from different supervision sources and reuse across different tasks, with a systematic training recipe. Existing benchmarks document these deficits separately but do not support controlled comparisons across scenes, actions, and reasoning operations. We therefore introduce WOVEN, a training source and benchmark for visual transition reasoning that organizes transition supervision by scene, action, and reasoning type, using diverse, realistic rollouts from video-pretrained generative models: 36,076 examples across 20 scene types, 5 action types, and 8 reasoning types. We first evaluate 38 frontier MLLMs (e.g., GPT-5.4 and Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B) and find a substantial and systematic deficit: even the strongest models fall far below humans, and the failures recur across model families and persist with scale. We then train MLLMs at multiple scales on WOVEN and find that they learn a shared capability that transfers broadly: training subsets of only about 2,000 items each collectively improve 22 of 26 external benchmarks by up to 27.3 percentage points, and WOVEN data can replace 30-50% of a task's own training data with comparable accuracy. Controlled comparisons further yield a training recipe for visual world modeling, validated prospectively on held-out benchmarks: select supervision by the reasoning operation it teaches rather than by the actions, scenes, or domains it shows, and prefer larger changes to the visual state for robustness. Our work establishes visual transition reasoning as a reusable foundation for systematic visual world-model training in MLLMs.

items.title: Predicting Alignment Generalization with Value Representations
items.title_zh: 用价值表示预测对齐泛化
items.summary_zh: LLM开发者对其模型进行后训练以展现亲社会价值观和行为特质，这些在对齐目标中被列举。然而，尽管最近的后训练发展产生了在对齐评估中得分很高的模型，在狭窄行为集上训练模型仍会以意想不到的方式影响其在未见上下文和环境中的行为。在本文中，我们建立对齐泛化预测任务，即预测将模型微调以遵循给定价值如何改变其在广泛留出价值上的行为。我们对现代对齐目标中66个价值的对齐泛化效应进行了大规模分析，并在对齐泛化预测任务上对表示技术进行基准测试。我们发现，基于模型在上下文中应用价值时的激活的表示显著优于基于价值文本描述的方法。具体而言，最佳基于激活的方法与我们的泛化矩阵达到0.45的相关性，而基于描述的基线为0.05。然后我们展示了预测对齐泛化的表示对下游任务的适用性，用它们测量多价值对齐目标中价值的相似程度，我们发现这与模型鲁棒性显著相关。最后，我们展示了朝向共享、模型无关价值空间的初步证据，并用其开发了第一

extra.description: LLM developers post-train their models to exhibit prosocial values and behavioral traits, which are enumerated in an alignment target. However, while recent post-training developments have yielded models that score highly on alignment evaluations, training models on sets of narrow behaviors still influences their behavior across unseen contexts and environments in unexpected ways. In this paper, we establish the task of alignment generalization prediction, i.e., predicting how fine-tuning a model to follow a given value changes its behavior across a wide range of held-out values. We conduct a large-scale analysis of alignment generalization effects across 66 values found in modern alignment targets, and benchmark representational techniques on the alignment generalization prediction task. We find that representations based on model activations when applying values in context significantly outperform methods based on textual descriptions of the values. Specifically, the best activations-based methods achieve correlations of 0.45 with our generalization matrix, compared with 0.05 from description-based baselines. We then show the applicability of representations that predict alignment generalization toward downstream tasks by using them to measure how similar the values in a multi-value alignment target are, which we find is significantly correlated with model robustness. Finally, we show initial evidence towards a shared, model-independent value space, which we use to develop the first taxonomy of LLM values grounded in empirical generalization dynamics. Our work demonstrates the importance of studying value generalization in LLMs and its application toward the more empirical design and training of model behavior.

items.title: Discovering Latent Scientific Concepts through Discrete Representation Learning
items.title_zh: 通过离散表示学习发现潜在科学概念
items.summary_zh: 科学成像正在经历根本性转变。多重免疫荧光、计算病理学和电子显微镜的进步使得以前所未有的空间分辨率观察生物和物理系统成为可能。这些数据不是简单地分类已知对象，而是提供了发现先前未知组织原理的机会。然而，科学图像数据集通常高度精选、信息丰富且规模有限，使得可靠的表示学习特别具有挑战性。我们表明，标准的连续自监督适应在这种情形下可能变得不稳定，允许教师表示漂移并降低下游迁移。我们引入Kodiak，一种离散表示学习架构，通过Sinkhorn平衡码本分配发现潜在科学概念。Kodiak不是学习无约束的连续嵌入，而是构建可重用的离散概念词汇表，在单阶段框架内为掩码块预测和跨视图表示学习提供稳定监督。在五个科学成像领域，包括胰腺癌病理多重免疫荧光和扫描电子显微镜，Kodiak在持续基础模型适应和从头训练下均持续改善表示质量。除了改善分类和迁移，学习到的概念是可解释的、可重用的，并产生空间连贯的概念图，支持

extra.description: Scientific imaging is undergoing a fundamental transformation. Advances in multiplex immunofluorescence, computational pathology, and electron microscopy now enable observation of biological and physical systems at unprecedented spatial resolution. Rather than simply classifying known objects, these data offer the opportunity to discover previously unknown organizational principles. However, scientific image datasets are typically highly curated, information-rich, and limited in size, making reliable representation learning particularly challenging. We show that standard continuous self-supervised adaptation can become unstable in this regime, allowing teacher representations to drift and degrading downstream transfer. We introduce Kodiak, a discrete representation learning architecture that discovers latent scientific concepts through Sinkhorn-balanced codebook assignments. Instead of learning unconstrained continuous embeddings, Kodiak constructs a reusable vocabulary of discrete concepts that provides stable supervision for both masked-patch prediction and cross-view representation learning within a single-stage framework. Across five scientific imaging domains, including multiplex immunofluorescence for pancreatic cancer pathology and scanning electron microscopy, Kodiak consistently improves representation quality under both continued foundation-model adaptation and training from scratch. Beyond improved classification and transfer,the learned concepts are interpretable, reusable, and produce spatially coherent concept maps that support applications such as cell phenotyping, segmentation-free patch phenotyping, spatial niche discovery, tissue organization, and materials characterization. We view Kodiak as the representation-learning engine of our foundation model for spatial biology. More broadly, our results suggest that discrete representation learning provides a principled foundation for discovering reusable latent scientific concepts that can accelerate scientific interpretation across imaging domains.

items.title: CRISPR-Cas9 Editing of Myeloid Lectins Reveals Target-Dependent Transcriptional Remodeling in Tumor-Associated Macrophages
items.title_zh: CRISPR-Cas9编辑髓系凝集素揭示肿瘤相关巨噬细胞中靶点依赖的转录重塑
items.summary_zh: 肿瘤相关巨噬细胞（TAM）整合多种微环境信号，包括凝集素介导的肿瘤相关聚糖识别。尽管几种髓系凝集素已被牵涉到肿瘤-巨噬细胞相互作用中，但它们对免疫抑制性TAM表型的贡献仍不明确。我们在原代人单核细胞中实施CRISPR-Cas9核糖核蛋白（RNP）工作流，以对我们先前报道的五种潜在免疫抑制性凝集素进行比较性功能缺失探究。CRISPR-Cas9 RNP递送条件在新鲜分离的单核细胞中以CD14作为技术靶点进行基准测试，随后在HeLa S3细胞中对CLEC4E、CLEC6A、CD209、SELL和SIGLEC9进行sgRNA编辑效率筛选。选定的引导RNA被应用于原代单核细胞，然后在与BT474乳腺癌细胞的3D模型中共培养。编辑通过Sanger测序解卷积定量，而共培养来源的CD45+巨噬细胞通过荧光激活细胞分选分离并通过bulk RNA测序表征。所有五种凝集素均被成功扰动，尽管基因编辑效率仍取决于靶

extra.description: Tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) integrate multiple microenvironmental signals, including lectin-mediated recognition of tumor-associated glycans. Although several myeloid lectins have been implicated in tumor-macrophage interactions, their contributions to immunosuppressive TAM phenotypes remain poorly defined. We implemented a CRISPR-Cas9 ribonucleoprotein (RNP) workflow in primary human monocytes to enable comparative loss-of-function interrogation of five potentially immunosuppressive lectins we previously reported. CRISPR-Cas9 RNP delivery conditions were benchmarked in freshly isolated monocytes using CD14 as a technical target, followed by sgRNA editing efficiency screening for CLEC4E, CLEC6A, CD209, SELL, and SIGLEC9 in HeLa S3 cells. Selected guides were applied to primary monocytes before co-culture in a 3D model with BT474 breast cancer cells. Editing was quantified by Sanger-sequencing deconvolution, while co-culture-derived CD45+ macrophages were isolated by fluorescence-activated cell sorting and characterized by bulk RNA sequencing. All five lectins were successfully perturbed, although gene editing efficiency remained target- and donor-dependent. Transcriptomic analysis revealed target-specific reprogramming and recurrent immunometabolic responses. mTORC1 signaling was consistently enriched, together with the remodeling of cholesterol homeostasis, fatty acid metabolism, and oxidative phosphorylation. CLEC6A deletion achieved attenuation of hypoxia-, angiogenesis-, and TNF/NF-kB-associated programs. CD209 and SIGLEC9 deletion similarly reduced hypoxia- and angiogenesis-associated signatures while promoting lipid and oxidative metabolism. CLEC4E perturbation induced broad remodeling of lipid and oxidative metabolism and stress-response, despite comparatively limited editing efficiency. Comparative lectin perturbation thus identified CLEC6A as the strongest candidate for further mechanistic investigation, while CLEC4E showed broad transcriptional remodeling despite lower editing efficiency, supporting its prioritization for improved genetic interrogation. Responses to CD209 and SIGLEC9 targeting further support tumor glycan-myeloid signaling as a regulator of TAM state. Overall, lectin perturbation redirected TAM transcriptional states through distinct immunometabolic programs rather than a uniform pro-inflammatory polarization, highlighting lectin-dependent immunometabolic regulation as a promising axis for further investigation.

items.title: 大学生骑车时被改装电动车撞后离世，家属称难以接受肇事者与死者共担事故同等责任，各方责任到底该咋划定？
items.title_zh: 大学生骑车时被改装电动车撞后离世，家属称难以接受肇事者与死者共担事故同等责任，各方责任到底该咋划定？
items.summary_zh: 4月29日，就读于海南琼台师范学院舞蹈专业的女生胡宝，在校园内骑车取快递时，遭一名外卖商家驾驶的电动车撞击，导致头部着地颅内出血，经抢救无效不幸离世。 家属描述，女儿当时正在骑行转弯，肇事的外卖商家驾车直行撞到了其电动车后轮。由于对方车辆经过改装、车身较重，冲击力巨大，造成了致命伤害。 涉事外卖商家所驾驶的车辆为改装车。事发后，家属与校方达成了调解协议，校方9月份开学后优化了校园电动车管理措施 据记者报道，贵州六盘水居民孟姐反映，女儿在海南琼台师范学院读舞蹈专业，骑车取快递被外卖商家改装电动车撞倒，抢救无效离世，难以接受肇事者、违停车主与女儿承担事故同等责任。 海口当地交警称，经过讨论才出具该份事故责任认定书，有异议可联系办案民警。 校方工作人员告诉记者，领导清楚该起电动车事件处理情况，由于其正在开会，暂时无法提供信息。 孟姐表示，女儿离世对家人打击很大，目前正通过检方帮助计划以涉嫌过失致

items.title: 女子买 42 元牛肉丸换支付方式付款被误会逃单，商家连发多条监控视频，商家这种行为涉嫌违法吗？
items.title_zh: 女子买 42 元牛肉丸换支付方式付款被误会逃单，商家连发多条监控视频，商家这种行为涉嫌违法吗？
items.summary_zh: 近日，桂林一女子在当地一家牛肉丸店消费，因微信余额不足切换支付宝支付42元后离店。店家听到微信取消付款提示，误以为顾客逃单，在群内发布监控视频，公开当事人画面。 李女士介绍，10月4日中午，她来到桂林汇东果蔬批发市场一家牛肉丸专卖店，用微信结账时，发现余额不足，取消付款后转而用支付宝付款42元，随后骑车离开。“当时取消微信付款后，确实听到了播报取消付款的声音，自己也没多想。”李女士回忆，没过多久，她刷到老板的朋友圈动态：有一个小姑娘没付款，不知道是忘记付了还是逃单，希望看到这个朋友圈来找我。 自己已经付款了，看到这条消息时，她并没有在意。很快，她在群里看到老板连续发了几条监控视频称：“我就不信了，这年头还有人逃单。”李女士点开视频，发现老板口中“逃单”的人正是自己。“脸看得一清二楚。”她说。视频公开后，群内多名网友纷纷指责称：“动不动就吃白食、白嫖”“丢脸，这就叫爱贪小便宜”…无端的指责让

items.title: 武汉一中学要求家长到校轮值延时晚自习，且必须是学生父母，当地教育局回应已介入调查，哪些信息值得关注？
items.title_zh: 武汉一中学要求家长到校轮值延时晚自习，且必须是学生父母，当地教育局回应已介入调查，哪些信息值得关注？
items.summary_zh: 10月8日，有家长反映武汉一所中学发通知称要求家长到学校教室轮值延时晚自习。通知称，轮值家长必须是学生父母，还要求家长记录不守纪律的学生。 9日，学校工作人员告诉记者，家长轮值系家校合作的教学方式，系自愿参加，如家长没时间可以跟班主任申请调整。记者从武昌区教育局获悉，确有此事，已介入调查处理。https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/3SLbLfoBRpqtPjOQ0TeZlQ

items.title: 贵州遵义一新郎婚礼当天就医输液后死亡，家属称输液区域监控未投入使用，公安已介入，哪些信息值得关注？
items.title_zh: 贵州遵义一新郎婚礼当天就医输液后死亡，家属称输液区域监控未投入使用，公安已介入，哪些信息值得关注？
items.summary_zh: 10月9日，“新郎婚礼当天去医院看病后离世”登上热搜，引发关注。 10月8日，有网友发布视频称，一名新郎在结婚当天于贵州遵义桐梓县人民医院就医后不幸离世，引发关注。桐梓县人民医院接线人员回应称，此事目前正在调查中，主管卫健部门及公安部门已介入，已委托尸检。 10月8日，桐梓县卫健局工作人员回应称：10月3日13时39分，35岁的谢某某在举办婚礼时感到身体不适，到桐梓县人民医院急诊科就诊，经抢救无效，于当日16时9分宣布死亡。事件发生后，卫健局与家属及时共同封存病历和药品。10月3日晚，谢某某家属及县医院共同委托重庆市法医学会司法鉴定所，对死亡原因进行鉴定。“待鉴定结果出具后，我们将客观公正依法依规及时处理。” 据企查查信息，桐梓县人民医院系一家三级综合医院，开办资金1.6亿余元。此外，该院目前已被限制高消费，且存在失信被执行人记录，涉案金额达7435万元。

items.title: 美政府暂停微软等多家科企外籍员工绿卡申请，这释放什么信号？会产生怎样的影响？
items.title_zh: 美政府暂停微软等多家科企外籍员工绿卡申请，这释放什么信号？会产生怎样的影响？
items.summary_zh: 美国联邦政府8日表示，将暂停微软等多家科技企业参与“永久劳工认证”计划。该计划是持有H-1B签证的外籍员工通过雇主申请美国职业移民永久居留权（绿卡）的第一步。同时，哈佛大学、斯坦福大学等9所美国大学正因“涉嫌J-1签证欺诈”而面临调查。 美国副总统万斯当天在白宫举行的新闻发布会上宣布针对微软的决定时称，该公司“存在欺诈行为”，微软必须雇用优秀的美国工人，“你们不能解雇美国工人，然后用条件不稳定的外国工人取而代之”。美国劳工部长桑德林补充说，奥多比、高知特、印孚瑟斯等大型科技公司将被暂停参与为其员工申请绿卡的计划，“我们将不再接受或处理任何涉及这些公司新的或待处理的永久劳工认证申请”。万斯说，针对相关科技企业的这一措施将持续到“必要期限”为止。 H-1B签证是美国的一种临时工作签证，属于非移民签证，有效期通常为三年，可延长至六年。该签证允许美国公司雇佣外籍专业技术人员，以填补国内难以找到合适

items.title: 21 岁中国篮球运动员庞清方赴美训练多年却遭 ICE 拘留，为何将面临离境风险？对其篮球生涯有何影响？
items.title_zh: 21 岁中国篮球运动员庞清方赴美训练多年却遭 ICE 拘留，为何将面临离境风险？对其篮球生涯有何影响？
items.summary_zh: 据中国侨网援引美国媒体报道，21岁中国旅美篮球运动员庞清方因移民身份问题，被美国移民及海关执法局（ICE）拘留，目前关押在路易斯安那州里奇伍德移民拘留中心，面临离境风险。 公开资料显示，庞清方2005年出生于篮球世家，从小接受篮球训练。2018年，庞清方代表深圳队出战广东省运动会，摘得乙组（U13）金牌。 少年时期赴美打球，先后就读美国新泽西州、纽约州的高中，之后进入纽约门罗大学。2025至2026赛季，他代表门罗大学出战31场比赛，其中27场首发，场均贡献8.3分。今年，庞清方获得密西西比河谷州立大学篮球奖学金，升入NCAA一级联盟球队，原定于11月开启新赛季。 据报道，9月29日，庞清方计划从密西西比州杰克逊市搭乘航班前往纽约，希望找一位家庭友人协助处理学生身份手续，在机场被ICE执法人员拦下拘留。 报道截图 图源：中国侨网 美国国土安全部（DHS）资料显示，庞清方2023年11月17

items.title: 如何看待《数学的黄金时代与数学家的失落时代》文章？你有哪些感受？
items.title_zh: 如何看待《数学的黄金时代与数学家的失落时代》文章？你有哪些感受？
items.summary_zh: 近年来，以大语言模型为代表的人工智能技术飞速发展，其影响已经从信息处理、内容生成等领域，逐步深入到科学研究的核心环节。数学作为最古老、也最依赖人类抽象思维能力的学科，正在成为这一轮技术变革冲击最为直接的领域之一。 近期发生的几件事情值得关注。9 月 8 日，OpenAI 宣布其内部模型构造出带光滑外力的三维纳维–斯托克斯方程的有限时间爆破解，称这解决了千禧年问题的相应版本，并称证明已经 Lean 形式化验证；该结果的来源目前尚有争议。10 月 6 日，OpenAI 一次性公开了 722 篇由该模型生成的数学手稿，归为 372 组；据其披露，这些结果出自研究人员提交给模型的约 4000 个未解研究问题，平均每个结果耗费的算力约相当于 ChatGPT Pro 思考三小时。其中一组手稿处理的是另一个千禧年问题霍奇猜想的若干特殊情形；这不等于一般的霍奇猜想已经解决，目录中也未见这一组配套的形式化证

items.title: 为什么学校不在一开始教人如何博弈，而是要教大家做老实人，社会上反复吃亏？
items.title_zh: 为什么学校不在一开始教人如何博弈，而是要教大家做老实人，社会上反复吃亏？
items.summary_zh: 教人博弈，不等于教人钻空子，也不等于教人算计别人。 首先，钻空子是有风险的。让更多的人学会博弈，可以让更多的人看懂规则。在大家都盯着的情况下，钻空子的风险也会被放大，这样反而可以减少钻空子的现象。 其次，钻空子之所以能够得逞，很大一部分原因是旁观者看不懂，当事人被蒙在鼓里。当所有人都具备博弈思维，就相当于群体眼光变敏锐，钻空子的行为更容易暴露，代价升高，收益下降，就能抑制投机行为。 你算计别人，前提是别人看不懂你。让更多的人学会博弈，反而会让善于算计的人更难得逞。 教人博弈，不是教人去害人，而是教人读懂人心，从而避免被算计。就像揭秘骗局，不是为了教别人当骗子，而是教别人如何避免被骗。

items.title: 有人说「很多过来人觉得一些事无足轻重，不是因为更成熟而是因为脱离那个环境了」，你怎么看这种说法？
items.title_zh: 有人说「很多过来人觉得一些事无足轻重，不是因为更成熟而是因为脱离那个环境了」，你怎么看这种说法？
items.summary_zh: 「很多人觉得一些事无足轻重，不是因为成长，而是因为你已经脱离那个环境了，不用再经历了。等你成年后，会觉得原生家庭无足轻重；等你毕业了，会觉得学校被孤立无足轻重，等你退休了，会觉得被领导穿小鞋无足轻重；问题只有在面对的时候才是问题」

items.title_zh: 如何看待现在大部分零零后学生几乎不会使用网址进行搜索？
items.summary_zh: 今天学校白板上的微信版本太低，老师需要重新装一个。旁边同学自告奋勇，打开浏览器百度搜"微信"，结果搜出来第一个是360安全卫士，第二个是金山毒霸，全是捆绑下载。我实在没办法，直接输入https://weixin.com打开官网，30秒就装好了。后来我观察了一下，不只是我们班，连老师都几乎不会直接输入网址了。遇到问题第一反应就是打开百度搜，完全不知道可以直接在地址栏输网址访问。想问一下，这种现象普遍吗？为什么现在大部分00后学生似乎已经丧失了"使用网址"的能力？

items.title: 为何中国三舱结构的神舟飞船都是一次性，而空叉公司小巧“龙飞船”可以“重复使用十多次”，共四个就够用？
items.title_zh: 为何中国三舱结构的神舟飞船都是一次性，而空叉公司小巧“龙飞船”可以“重复使用十多次”，共四个就够用？
items.summary_zh: 根据2022年SpaceX官方表态，公司已完成第四艘也是最后一艘载人龙飞船的生产，整个载人龙飞船（Crew Dragon） 机队将严格维持在四艘。 · 机队名单：这四艘在役飞船分别是“奋进号”（Endeavour）、“坚韧号”（Resilience）、“耐力号”（Endurance）和“自由号”（Freedom）。 · 停产的考量：此举主要基于两点关键考量： · 重复使用的经济性：飞船设计可重复使用十余次，四艘足以满足当前NASA及商业合同需求。 · 集中资源开发下一代飞船：为将人力物力集中于“星舰”（Starship）项目，为未来的深空探索做准备。
